AckRequest.description: The body of a "mark as read": the empty JSON object.
AckRequest.title: AckRequest

CoralError.description: What was refused: a stable ``code``, a message for people, and machine-readable details.
CoralError.title: CoralError

CoralErrorResponse.description: The body of every Coral refusal.
CoralErrorResponse.title: CoralErrorResponse

GateOut.description: A gate visit waiting for its answer.
GateOut.title: GateOut

InvalidResult.description: A workflow document that did not load.
InvalidResult.title: InvalidResult

JoinInfo.description: How a node with several incoming arrows combines them.
JoinInfo.title: JoinInfo

JsonPatch.description: One JSON Patch operation addressed by a JSON pointer.
JsonPatch.title: JsonPatch

LabelSet.description: Labels on the label-selected outgoing arrows of a node.
LabelSet.title: LabelSet

LoadError.description: A document that could not be loaded; ``issues`` lists every schema error.
LoadError.title: LoadError

LogEntryOut.description:
One run-log row with its body. ``body`` is ``None`` for a row whose text cannot be
read (``kind`` ``log.unreadable``) and, with ``body_truncated``, for a body too large
to send.
LogEntryOut.title: LogEntryOut

LogPage.description: Log rows in ``seq`` order; ``next_after_seq`` is set when more rows follow.
LogPage.title: LogPage

LoopInfo.description: A loop closed by one back-arrow.
LoopInfo.title: LoopInfo

Problem.description: One finding, anchored to nodes, arrows and a ``yaml_path``.
Problem.title: Problem

Region.description: Parallel region between an unlabelled split and its AND-join.
Region.title: Region

RequiredCommand.description:
One command that must pass after the step's last change.

:param run: One plain command, e.g. ``pytest -q``, matched as the last command
    of an ``&&`` chain (``coral.evidence.match``).
:param may_modify: The command may change the tree (a formatter); its own
    changes do not count as the step's last change when it runs on its own.
:param allow_args: A run may add arguments after ``run``; by default the
    argv must be exactly ``run``'s.
RequiredCommand.title: RequiredCommand

RunDetail.description:
One run in full. ``view`` is ``None`` and ``load_error`` is set for a run that
cannot be loaded; ``target``, ``max_activations`` and ``request_preview`` are
``None`` when its stored rows cannot be read.
RunDetail.title: RunDetail

RunPage.description: One page of runs, newest first; page again with ``next_cursor`` until it is null.
RunPage.title: RunPage

RunSpend.description:
What a run has spent so far, as last read: shown, never capped.

``usd`` is the display figure its anchor's badge shows, ``live_usd`` includes
spend still in flight; both are ``None`` when no session was priced and a lower
bound when ``unpriced_models`` is not empty. ``as_of`` is when it was read.
RunSpend.title: RunSpend

RunSpendTokens.description: Tokens a run's sessions used, summed over its whole session tree.
RunSpendTokens.title: RunSpendTokens

RunSummary.description: A run as its owner's run list shows it.
RunSummary.title: RunSummary

RunTarget.description: Where the run works: its host, repository and worktree branch.
RunTarget.title: RunTarget

SavedWorkflowOut.description: The definition a save stored, with the validation of what was saved.
SavedWorkflowOut.title: SavedWorkflowOut

SlotOut.description: An agent slot of one of the run's steps.
SlotOut.title: SlotOut

SourceRange.description: 1-based inclusive start, exclusive end positions in the YAML text.
SourceRange.title: SourceRange

UnresolvedFact.description: Something Analysis could not resolve; blocks running the workflow.
UnresolvedFact.title: UnresolvedFact

ValidResult.description: A workflow that loaded and compiled, with what validation found.
ValidResult.title: ValidResult

WorkflowAlertOut.description: One open alert as the Inbox lists it: its row's fields merged with its payload.
WorkflowAlertOut.title: WorkflowAlertOut

WorkflowDetailOut.description: A stored workflow definition with its YAML and compiled graph.
WorkflowDetailOut.title: WorkflowDetailOut

WorkflowInboxPage.description:
One feed page. A page can be empty and still carry ``next_cursor``: keep paging
until it is null.
WorkflowInboxPage.title: WorkflowInboxPage

WorkflowSummaryOut.description: A stored workflow definition as lists show it.
WorkflowSummaryOut.title: WorkflowSummaryOut

WorkflowYaml.description: A workflow document as YAML text.
WorkflowYaml.title: WorkflowYaml
